authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.1–20.2, 20.4.8, 20.4.16 and 20.4.17; independent producer witness docs/research/p6-ac1015-compound-entity-chain-witness-2026-11-04.json.
scope: Explicit AC1015 DRW_DwgLegacyPolylineChainProvider extends the separately opted-in predeclared model chain with concrete 2D/3D POLYLINE parents, at least two planned vertices and a separately planned SEQEND. Children form their own soft-pointer predecessor/successor list, SEQEND has null neighbors, and the parent alone belongs to the model-space list. All identities and links are fixed before frame receipts. INSERT, empty/singleton, mesh/polyface, spline/fit flags, nonrepresentable fields, retained SEQEND metadata, paper space, named blocks and raw replay remain refused. Existing non-opt-in paths remain unchanged.
source_witness: ODA 27.1 producer plus independent LibreDWG decode, documented in p6-ac1015-compound-entity-chain-witness-2026-11-04.json.

oda_output.reader: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 ACAD2013 DXF; actual DXF and no .err confirmed, not merely exit status. Each profile uses the explicit model/compound chain and default plotstyle providers.

rich_2d.observed: Parent widths 0.5/0.75 and thickness 0.25; first vertex widths 0.2/0.4, bulge 0.25 and tangent 0.75 radians retained.

two_parents.observed: Separate 2D and 3D polylines each retain their own two vertices and SEQEND.

elevated_tilted_2d_scratch.observed: Parent elevation 5 and extrusion (0,0.6,0.8) and equal vertex z=5 retained; no rendering or OCS world-space claim.

oda_output.singleton_exclusion: Earlier generated singleton DWG SHA f20a1a7cacf2e8a318187513cba43651bc368ef306cf002b4c7497e6f1cdbca8 converted to DXF with two identical vertices. Singleton is therefore refused rather than treated as exact parity.

validation: PASS libdxfrw_dwg_legacy_polyline_chain, legacy_model_chain_optin, header_writer_sealing and default_plotstyle_optin; LC3 compatibility target builds. Controls cover independent parent/child/SEQEND roles and immutable receipts, same-facade rollback/retry including late SEQEND false-return and early/late bad_alloc, full raw APPID/LAYER pending-reference restoration, identity and owner alias rejection, aggregate >1,000,000 identity refusal before index construction, unrepresentable field refusal and multiple parent isolation. GNU LibreDWG 0.14 independently verifies topology and geometry for retained generated profiles; its JSON omits 2D vertex widths, independently confirmed by -v4 trace.
limits: No broad AC1015 interoperability, compound INSERT, CAD rendering/editing, cross-platform or DWG/DXF parity claim. Explicit 3D vertex flag 32 has local receipt/readback coverage and independent source witness; the cited ODA output samples use default vertex flags. No locally generated DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
